title: Cyclic $L_3$ Models and Holomorphic Reduction in Heterotic $G_2$ Deformation Theory
summary: We construct a finite cyclic $L_3$ presentation (that is, a cyclic $L_\infty$ algebra with brackets vanishing above arity three) of the variational deformation theory defined by the heterotic $G_2$ superpotential near a torsion-free standard embedding, to first order in $α'$. Auxiliary fields for the inverse coframe, spinor derivative, flux and induced tangent connection give a shifted-cotangent Hamiltonian of degree at most four.
